requirements: R1: Start the full stack via a docker-compose.yml file at the repository root
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint to verify the stack's real-world behavior

slices.title: Add docker-compose.yml with health check
slices.jtbd: When implementing the containerization for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose file, so that the full stack can be launched locally with a single command and verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean checkout of the repository, When I run `docker-compose up`, Then the database, backend, and frontend containers start successfully.
Given the containers are running, When I send a GET request to the health-check endpoint, Then it responds with HTTP 200 OK.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment setup time from manual steps to 1 command

requirements: R1: Update existing materials from the UI by invoking the corresponding PUT API endpoint
R2: Delete existing materials from the UI by invoking the corresponding DELETE API endpoint

slices.title: Wire up update and delete actions in existing material UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing the update and delete functionality for this epic, I want to patch the existing frontend views, so that users can trigger the PUT and DELETE endpoints directly from the UI.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the UI, When a user clicks edit and saves changes, Then the frontend invokes the PUT API endpoint with the updated data.
Given an existing material in the UI, When a user clicks delete and confirms, Then the frontend invokes the DELETE API endpoint to remove the material.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase material management capability coverage from 50% to 100% of CRUD operations

epics.title: System Authentication and Session Control
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthenticated unauthorized access incidents to 0
requirements: R1: Require users to authenticate before accessing the material catalog
R2: Block unauthenticated users from creating materials and prompt them to log in

slices.title: Patch existing code to enforce authentication checks
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to add session checks to the existing endpoints and views, so that unauthenticated access is strictly blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the material catalog, Then they are redirected to the login prompt.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a new material via API or UI, Then the system blocks the action and returns an unauthorized error.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase authenticated session enforcement to 100% of restricted routes
